practice.question: Can two block outputs be averaged equally?
practice.answer: Only in the special case that their softmax partition masses are equal. In general merge numerators and denominators after correcting maxima; then divide once.
practice.rubric: Name the lost denominator and the rescaling.

practice.question: Does avoiding N-squared storage eliminate N-squared comparisons?
practice.answer: No. Dense attention still compares every allowed query/key pair. Tiling reduces intermediate storage and IO; sparse connectivity changes which pairs are computed.
practice.rubric: Distinguish pair count, storage and IO.
